name: io.github.cyanheads/uk-legislation-mcp-server
description: Search and read UK legislation at any date, resolve citations, list amendments, track changes.

environmentVariables.name: UK_LEGISLATION_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: Email or URL appended to the User-Agent so legislation.gov.uk can reach the operator. Optional; set it on hosted deployments.

environmentVariables.name: UK_LEGISLATION_MIN_REQUEST_GAP_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum gap between legislation.gov.uk request starts, in ms (minimum 250). Replicas sharing one User-Agent divide the fair use limit: use at least 250 ms x replica count.

environmentVariables.name: UK_LEGISLATION_CACHE_MAX_MB
environmentVariables.description: Response cache size bound, in MB (8-1024).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
